_doc: DISPLAY-ONLY placeholders for the two-corner test. None of these touch scoring. Values marked PLACEHOLDER have no approved number (06-pattern-read: 'No distance number is approved; readability tests set it later').

visual_gap._doc: PLACEHOLDER. drawn rival offset: lead<=0 -> ahead by min(max(min_spacing, -lead*scale), cap) [tie draws rival min_spacing ahead]; lead>0 -> behind by max(min_spacing, lead*scale), UNCAPPED (recedes in mirror).

qte._doc: PROVISIONAL UX: needle pos = sin(2*pi*t/period); score = clamp(round(10 - 9*|pos|), 1, 10); no press before playback ends -> PLAYER_QTE_MIN

road_scroller._doc: guide §14.2 RoadScroller + §13.1. GUIDE constants: scroll_speed (UV/s), corner burst factor 1.5 for 0.5 s then 0.6. Everything else here is a DISPLAY PLACEHOLDER (guide gives no value).
road_scroller._straight_factor_doc: PLACEHOLDER: guide says 'faster during straight' but gives no value; 1.0 = baseline scroll_speed
road_scroller._road_uv_length_doc: PLACEHOLDER: metres of road per 1.0 of uv_offset (guide gives no texture scale) -> 0.05*1.0*500 = 25 m/s on the straight
road_scroller._wheel_doc: PLACEHOLDER: true v/r (~80 rad/s) aliases at 60 fps on a 10-sided wheel
road_scroller._bob_doc: PLACEHOLDER: identical vertical bob on both cars, no pitch/roll (not a suspension tell, per 06)
road_scroller._straight_range: PLACEHOLDER; 384 m = multiple of every lamp period (24, 48) so streamed lamps stay on the painted pools

corner_cams._doc: guide §13.1/§13.3 authored corner camera per turn type; §12.2 transition_to_corner offsets/tween. ALL KEYFRAMES ARE DISPLAY PLACEHOLDERS. Points are path-relative: a = fraction along the arc (negative = metres before the arc via s_m), d_in = metres toward the INSIDE of the corner (negative = outside), h = height. Camera looks at the player car.
corner_cams._offset_doc: guide §12.2: left -> origin+(-3,0.5,1), right -> origin+(3,0.5,1) (x mirrored by direction), tween 1.0 s ease-in-out
corner_cams._swing_doc: §13.2 overtake 0.5-1 s (guide §12.2 says a 0.3 s camera shift: open mismatch); amplitude PLACEHOLDER
corner_cams.overtake_rule: AUSTIN OVERRIDE of guide 13.2 step 9a: no swing_overtake animation; on a leader change the cars hold position through the corner camera and snap to the new visual-gap positions when the camera reaches the rear chase lock
